image_description: A side-profile view of a reddish-brown horse (sorrel) standing in an outdoor enclosure with green vegetation and a fence in the background. The horse is wearing a halter.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with large expressive eyes and mobile ears.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head profile is clearly visible, showing correct equine proportions, visible eye, and upright ears.
The neck exhibits a natural arch and muscular definition consistent with an athletic horse.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Athletic build with tall, lean proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horse displays a fit, athletic physique with well-defined withers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat is a consistent reddish-brown (chestnut/sorrel). There are no black markings on the lower legs or ear tips (points).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mane matches the body color. The tail is partially visible and appears consistent with the body color.
The torso shows appropriate depth behind the shoulder and a level, strong topline.
The rear of the horse is cut off by the image frame; the tail is not fully visible to assess length or flow.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front legs are slender and anatomically correct. Hooves are present at the bottom of the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the halter appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper detail of the horse's hair, lacking distinct stitching or leather grain.
The background exhibits a uniform, slightly synthetic blur typical of AI generation or aggressive depth-of-field simulation, lacking natural optical bokeh characteristics.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific breed/color classification (Sorrel/Chestnut) and rule out misclassification as a generic horse or other equine.
To verify the structural integrity of the legs, spine, and head alignment, ensuring no hidden limb fusion or skeletal errors.
To check for edge bleeding between the halter and the horse's face, a common area for AI artifacts.
To assess the overall coherence of lighting and texture consistency across the subject and background.

focus_areas: Halfter attachment points and strap continuity
Coat texture uniformity vs. background noise
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the halter; AI often struggles with complex strapping systems on animals. Verify if the 'no black points' rule is strictly adhered to in the lower legs which are near the frame edge. Check if the background blur hides any structural inconsistencies in the fence line.
